# laravelforge_nginx_template (Data Source)

Fetches a single Laravel Forge nginx template by ID on a server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the nginx template.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the template belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) Nginx configuration template content.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `name` (String) Template name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
